children: By Stephen Nakrosis and Josh Beckerman
A group made up of LS Power Equity Advisors and certain affiliates submitted a non-binding proposal to buy the shares of EVgo they don't already own for $2 each.
LS Power currently holds about 56% of the combined voting power of EVgo's outstanding common stock.
Electric-vehicle-charging company EVgo said its board established a committee, made up of independent and disinterested directors, to review and evaluate the proposal.
EVgo shares closed up 47%, to $1.85, Monday. Volume topped 72 million shares.

The LS Power group said in a securities filing that "we have no interest in a disposition or sale of our holdings in the Company, and we have no interest in participating in an alternative change of control transaction."
LS Power bought EVgo from Vision Ridge Partners in 2020. The company went public via a 2021 deal with a special-purpose acquisition company.
Since early August, analysts from Stifel, UBS, RBC Capital and other firms have reduced their price targets for EVgo shares.
